title: Donald Trump and China President Xi Jinping Want Jensen Back at Nvidia!
gist: Report that President Trump publicly called for Jensen Huang to apologize and return as Nvidia CEO, saying Xi Jinping shared his view, putting him at odds with Nvidia's board which had said it would not reinstate Huang; the dispute plays out amid a Megaspeed chip-diversion probe and congressional scrutiny of Commerce Secretary Lutnick.

insights.claim: President Donald Trump said Jensen Huang should make a big apology and return as Nvidia CEO, publicly backing his reinstatement days after Nvidia's board rejected the idea.
insights.speaker: B
insights.so_what: Unusual presidential intervention in a corporate governance decision at a strategic company.
